items: AI works best on high-volume, repetitive and always-on work, because it spots patterns across thousands of data points and watches every interaction around the clock.
Customer support is the natural first use case: AI can draft review replies, sort reviews by sentiment, and surface the recurring complaints that point to an operational problem.
Start with one task that takes up a lot of staff time or regularly gets missed, measure its value, and only then expand AI to other areas of the business.
Before you buy, check that the tool solves a real problem, integrates with your existing systems, is built for restaurants, and needs a level of human oversight your team can give.
